claim: A door that opens by lifting its ceiling has a roofed ceiling: its ceiling IS the moving part, and as sky it would be a hole in the roof showing daylight in a building. A door that opens by dropping its floor may be open to the sky (a gate in an outdoor wall). Of the campaign's Z-motion sectors (600/602) 6 of 779 that move their ceiling are open to the sky (0.8%, all six in E6M4), against 95 of 658 that move their floor (14.4%).
evidence: recount 2026-11-26 over the 43 campaign maps (every type 600/602 sector with an XSECTOR, moving ceiling = off_ceiling_z != on_ceiling_z, open = ceiling_stat bit 0): 6/779 against 95/658

the rule's own text, bloodmap/rules_blood.py 'ceiling-mover-is-not-open-to-the-sky', says 18.4% against 0.5% with three in one map; that was not reproduced over all Z-motion sectors and may have counted doors only
both poses rendered when the rule was written (its first version asserted the opposite)
use: Give a ceiling-lifting door a real ceiling; use a floor-dropping gate under the sky.
